summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The MicroSectors 3x Long Semiconductor ETNs (SMHU) is an exchange-traded product that is based on the VettaFi Semiconductor Fund-Tracking index. The fund is a note, a debt obligation of the issuing bank. The note seeks to provide 3x the leveraged daily closing price of the VettaFi Semiconductor Fund-Tracking Index, before fees and expenses, resetting daily SMHU was launched on Aug 5, 2026 and is issued by REX Microsectors.
